commit_message:
Introduce LauncherProcessImageListener for downscaling images in Launcher.

This listener implements ImageDecoder.OnHeaderDecodedListener to automatically downscale images during decoding if their width or height exceeds a specified maximum memory constraint. This helps prevent excessive memory usage when loading large images in the Launcher process.

Bug: 468061774
